'''Vekker''' was a male [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] reign. 
==Biography==
Vekker started his career as a [[aide|servant]] for a Black Sun [[Sublieutenant/Legends|sublieutenant]]. However his master fell victim of others's subterfuge and was eliminated, and was replaced by Vekker. Vekker served his master, a Vigo  of Xizor, who had built a self-sufficient criminal empire of entertainment industries, [[cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[hotel/Legends|hotels]], [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]] and [[casino/Legends|casinos]] over the years; but when the [[Dark Prince]] learned that the Vigo tried to betray him, he had him eliminated. Therefore his sublieutenant Vekker filled his place, inheriting his syndicate.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The entertainment industry had stable income and operated by itself; while some of his enterprises were Black Sun fronts, others were legal. Vekker did not involve himself much with running these businesses and didn't need to fall into risks to expand them. Known by Xizor as being content with the status quo, he had no ambition to rise any higher within the organization and remained a modest and unremarkable Vigo.<ref name="sb" /><ref name="novel" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Vekker, he was certain that it was not himself; he was the less ambitious and less devious of the rest, and wondered who had crossed their master until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref name="obvious">{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> At the conclusion of the meeting, Vekker witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

After Xizor's death in the [[Battle over Coruscant]], the Black Sun was in the verge of an [[Black Sun civil war|internecine crime war]]. The Vigos assembled in a council where Vekker was seen arguing loudly with [[Sprax]].<ref name="SEE3">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 3]]</ref>

[[Savan]] staged a fake assault against the Vigos and accused Vekker, instigating a feud.<ref name="SEE3" /> Soon after Vekker was hunted and killed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 4">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 4|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 4]]</ref>
==Personality and traits==
Vekker was named after a [[Vekker (creature)|predatory species]] native to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

Perhaps because of his servantile background, Vekker displayed no significant ambitions or want to risk his safety and status for treachery; he saw his advancement from servant to Vigo, simply as a servant changing masters, still being a servant to Xizor.<ref name="sb" /> Vekker was not an agent of change, because he believed that change brought risk and difficulties.<ref name="obvious" />

As a Vigo, he kept a modest operation, without dreams of advancement or unduly expansion; his (lack of) ambition was mirrored in both without and within the Black Sun. Xizor appreciated his stable revenues, and was sure that he had no thoughts of undermining other Vigos's or Xizor's position.<ref name="sb" />
